title: The quiz shows the previous lesson's questions and answers are rejected
scenario: On slow connections learners click a new lesson and still see the previous lesson's quiz; submitting fails with a 409 'quiz item does not belong to lesson'. L2 blames CDN caching and wants no-store. You get a HAR summary, client error beacons, CDN headers and the RxJS store behind the screen.
task: Reproduce the bug in a test with responses released out of order
Rule the cache theory in or out
Fix the store: latest wins, cancel in flight, clear and gate submit
acceptance: Hidden jest tests for ordering, cancellation, gating and recovery
Root cause and evidence in ANSWER.md
